review_class: exploratory post-call AI review; source-only and unmasked to reference statuses and synthetic records; no human adjudication
independence: Only the assigned author-only packet, its index and frozen rubric were read for A3; no peer review, private linkage, live recipient outputs or aggregate outcomes were consulted. Graph execution contract was separately supplied identically to both reviewers by the fixture author. No local checker execution was performed.
interpretation: Criterion booleans for claim, routes, objections, resolution and qualification assess distinguishable semantic content in the actual response text where present. `provenance_time` requires a usable binding to the supplied tool/envelope context, which no final candidate provides under its requested format. `three_state_status` requires the unchanged emitted candidate to run and yield the reference vector; it fails for all 32 because the requested format is invalid. `unfaithful` is an author-artifact judgment, not a recipient outcome. No repair of source, JSON, graph keys or record paths was allowed.
cross_item_caveats: The actual prompts request an EAL/2 source or generic graph and list desired constructs, but do not provide the complete grammar or the checker’s precise generic field/typed-scope/path contract. Format failures therefore measure performance under those exact prompts, not competence after a full schema handoff.

The synthetic alert value in the inspected reference records omits `trial` while its acquisition request/context includes exact asset and trial. Several authored candidates inspect only value fields and consequently reject a valid scoped alert or resolution.
All final author outputs were retained. This review establishes no conclusion about A3 recipient performance, host packet fidelity, all-in cost, real cluster correctness or human agreement.
